§33.10(i) Large ρ

ⓘ
Keywords:
Coulomb functions: variables ρ,η, large ρ, limiting forms
Notes:
See Yost et al. (1936).
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/33.10.i
See also:
Annotations for §33.10 and Ch.33

As ρ→∞ with η fixed,

33.10.1 Fℓ⁡(η,ρ) =sin⁡(θℓ⁡(η,ρ))+o⁡(1),
Gℓ⁡(η,ρ) =cos⁡(θℓ⁡(η,ρ))+o⁡(1),
ⓘ
Symbols:
θℓ⁡(η,ρ): phase of Coulomb functions, cos⁡z: cosine function, Gℓ⁡(η,ρ): irregular Coulomb radial function, o⁡(x): order less than, Fℓ⁡(η,ρ): regular Coulomb radial function, sin⁡z: sine function, ℓ: nonnegative integer, ρ: nonnegative real variable and η: real parameter
Referenced by:
item 1
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/33.10.E1
Encodings:
TeX, TeX, pMML, pMML, png, png
See also:
Annotations for §33.10(i), §33.10 and Ch.33
33.10.2 Hℓ±⁡(η,ρ)∼exp⁡(±i⁢θℓ⁡(η,ρ)),
ⓘ
Symbols:
θℓ⁡(η,ρ): phase of Coulomb functions, ∼: asymptotic equality, exp⁡z: exponential function, i: imaginary unit, Hℓ±⁡(η,ρ): irregular Coulomb radial functions, ℓ: nonnegative integer, ρ: nonnegative real variable and η: real parameter
A&S Ref:
14.6.5
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/33.10.E2
Encodings:
TeX, pMML, png

where θℓ⁡(η,ρ) is defined by (33.2.9).

§33.10(ii) Large Positive η

ⓘ
Keywords:
Coulomb functions: variables ρ,η, large |η|, limiting forms
Notes:
See Fröberg (1955), Humblet (1984), Humblet (1985, Eqs. 2.10a,b). For (33.10.6) use (33.2.5), (33.2.10), and §5.11(i).
Referenced by:
Erratum (V1.0.19) for Subsections 33.10(ii), 33.10(iii)
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/33.10.ii
Errata (effective with 1.0.19):
In the first sentence, originally it was stated that ρ was fixed. This has been corrected to state that η⁢ρ is fixed.

Reported 2018-05-15 by Ian Thompson

See also:
Annotations for §33.10 and Ch.33

As η→∞ with η⁢ρ fixed,

33.10.3 Fℓ⁡(η,ρ) ∼(2⁢ℓ+1)!⁢Cℓ⁡(η)(2⁢η)ℓ+1⁢(2⁢η⁢ρ)1/2⁢I2⁢ℓ+1⁡((8⁢η⁢ρ)1/2),
Gℓ⁡(η,ρ) ∼2⁢(2⁢η)ℓ(2⁢ℓ+1)!⁢Cℓ⁡(η)⁢(2⁢η⁢ρ)1/2⁢K2⁢ℓ+1⁡((8⁢η⁢ρ)1/2).
ⓘ
Symbols:
Cℓ⁡(η): normalizing constant for Coulomb radial functions, ∼: asymptotic equality, !: factorial (as in n!), Gℓ⁡(η,ρ): irregular Coulomb radial function, Iν⁡(z): modified Bessel function of the first kind, Kν⁡(z): modified Bessel function of the second kind, Fℓ⁡(η,ρ): regular Coulomb radial function, ℓ: nonnegative integer, ρ: nonnegative real variable and η: real parameter
A&S Ref:
14.6.7
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/33.10.E3
Encodings:
TeX, TeX, pMML, pMML, png, png
See also:
Annotations for §33.10(ii), §33.10 and Ch.33

In particular, for ℓ=0,

33.10.4 F0⁡(η,ρ) ∼e−π⁢η⁢(π⁢ρ)1/2⁢I1⁡((8⁢η⁢ρ)1/2),
G0⁡(η,ρ) ∼2⁢eπ⁢η⁢(ρ/π)1/2⁢K1⁡((8⁢η⁢ρ)1/2),
ⓘ
Symbols:
∼: asymptotic equality, π: the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter, e: base of natural logarithm, Gℓ⁡(η,ρ): irregular Coulomb radial function, Iν⁡(z): modified Bessel function of the first kind, Kν⁡(z): modified Bessel function of the second kind, Fℓ⁡(η,ρ): regular Coulomb radial function, ρ: nonnegative real variable and η: real parameter
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/33.10.E4
Encodings:
TeX, TeX, pMML, pMML, png, png
See also:
Annotations for §33.10(ii), §33.10 and Ch.33
33.10.5 F0′⁡(η,ρ) ∼e−π⁢η⁢(2⁢π⁢η)1/2⁢I0⁡((8⁢η⁢ρ)1/2),
G0′⁡(η,ρ) ∼−2⁢eπ⁢η⁢(2⁢η/π)1/2⁢K0⁡((8⁢η⁢ρ)1/2).
ⓘ
Symbols:
∼: asymptotic equality, π: the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter, e: base of natural logarithm, Gℓ⁡(η,ρ): irregular Coulomb radial function, Iν⁡(z): modified Bessel function of the first kind, Kν⁡(z): modified Bessel function of the second kind, Fℓ⁡(η,ρ): regular Coulomb radial function, ρ: nonnegative real variable and η: real parameter
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/33.10.E5

TeX, TeX, pMML, pMML, png, png

Also,

33.10.6 σ0⁡(η) =η⁢(ln⁡η−1)+14⁢π+o⁡(1),
C0⁡(η) ∼(2⁢π⁢η)1/2⁢e−π⁢η.
ⓘ
Symbols:
Cℓ⁡(η): normalizing constant for Coulomb radial functions, σℓ⁡(η): Coulomb phase shift, ∼: asymptotic equality, π: the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter, e: base of natural logarithm, o⁡(x): order less than, ln⁡z: principal branch of logarithm function and η: real parameter

§33.10(iii) Large Negative η

ⓘ
Keywords:
Coulomb functions: variables ρ,η, large |η|, limiting forms
Notes:
See Humblet (1985, Eqs. 4.7a,b). For (33.10.10) use (33.2.5), (33.2.10), and §5.11(i).
Referenced by:
Erratum (V1.0.19) for Subsections 33.10(ii), 33.10(iii)
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/33.10.iii
Errata (effective with 1.0.19):
In the first sentence, originally it was stated that ρ was fixed. This has been corrected to state that η⁢ρ is fixed.

Reported 2018-05-15 by Ian Thompson

See also:
Annotations for §33.10 and Ch.33

As η→−∞ with η⁢ρ fixed,

33.10.7 Fℓ⁡(η,ρ) =(2⁢ℓ+1)!⁢Cℓ⁡(η)(−2⁢η)ℓ+1⁢((−2⁢η⁢ρ)1/2⁢J2⁢ℓ+1⁡((−8⁢η⁢ρ)1/2)+o⁡(|η|1/4)),
Gℓ⁡(η,ρ) =−π⁢(−2⁢η)ℓ(2⁢ℓ+1)!⁢Cℓ⁡(η)⁢((−2⁢η⁢ρ)1/2⁢Y2⁢ℓ+1⁡((−8⁢η⁢ρ)1/2)+o⁡(|η|1/4)).
ⓘ
Symbols:
Jν⁡(z): Bessel function of the first kind, Yν⁡(z): Bessel function of the second kind, Cℓ⁡(η): normalizing constant for Coulomb radial functions, π: the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter, !: factorial (as in n!), Gℓ⁡(η,ρ): irregular Coulomb radial function, o⁡(x): order less than, Fℓ⁡(η,ρ): regular Coulomb radial function, ℓ: nonnegative integer, ρ: nonnegative real variable and η: real parameter
A&S Ref:
14.6.7
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/33.10.E7
Encodings:
TeX, TeX, pMML, pMML, png, png
See also:
Annotations for §33.10(iii), §33.10 and Ch.33

In particular, for ℓ=0,

33.10.8 F0⁡(η,ρ) =(π⁢ρ)1/2⁢J1⁡((−8⁢η⁢ρ)1/2)+o⁡(|η|−1/4),
G0⁡(η,ρ) =−(π⁢ρ)1/2⁢Y1⁡((−8⁢η⁢ρ)1/2)+o⁡(|η|−1/4).
ⓘ
